signature.composition: large eye above PLC containing tag

prompt: One SQUARE flat software icon on white for reading a PLC tag. Draw a bold blue EYE across the TOP. Below it draw a large simple dark navy industrial controller with a big white display and two thick module divisions. On the controller display place a large orange tag silhouette with a clear white hole. Eye and controller are two large shapes. Make the eye and embedded tag recognizable at 30x18. No arrow, no letters, no shadow; keep all artwork inside central 70 percent of canvas.
